about: Every binary release.yml downloads by address and then runs or ships, with the
SHA-256 it must have (tools/build_inputs.py fetch <name> <file> stops otherwise),
and the commit each source tree cloned by tag must be (verify-git).
sources are tried in order; a release of dopeIPTV's own that shipped the same
bytes is listed last, since it stays when upstream's file has moved on.
How to change one: docs/MAINTAINING.md, 'What the build downloads'.

appimagetool-x86_64.what: appimagetool: packs the AppImage (a build tool, not shipped). AppImageKit's last build, unchanged since March 2023.

appimage-runtime-x86_64.what: The static type2 runtime every AppImage starts with (shipped: it is what runs first). AppImage/type2-runtime at fedfad5 (2026-10-19), the one in dopeIPTV 1.6.8.

appimage-runtime-aarch64.what: The type2 runtime of the aarch64 AppImage, the one in dopeIPTV 1.6.8.

libmpv-windows-x86_64.what: libmpv for Windows x64 with FFmpeg linked in (shipped as mpv-2.dll): zhongfly/mpv-winbuild 2026-11-19-b7339522cd, the one in dopeIPTV 1.6.8. Upstream keeps a build 30 days; the release that shipped it keeps it for good.

libmpv-windows-aarch64.what: libmpv for Windows on ARM (shipped as mpv-2.dll): zhongfly/mpv-winbuild 2026-11-19-b7339522cd, the one in dopeIPTV 1.6.8.

micromamba-osx-64.what: micromamba 2.10.0 for the Intel Mac build: installs conda-forge's libraries there (a build tool, not shipped). conda-forge's own package, which micro.mamba.pm hands out as 'latest'.

vulkan-loader.what: Khronos' Vulkan loader, built from source into vulkan-1.dll (shipped on Windows).

mpv.what: mpv's source, built into libmpv for the Intel Mac build at the version conda-forge's mpv package has.
